svg.title: What Suraj builds, and the life around it

g.text: SQL models for BMI, patients, and care decisions
GenAI that adapts nutrition science, not just chats it
Sales systems and ventures that actually ship
Ancient food wisdom, weighed and written down.
Leaf, spice, and the plate as a dataset.
Giridhari Traders, and whatever the next bet is.
A shop floor mind with a lab notebook.
GenAI, agents, and models with the examples attached.
Color, Canva, and stories people can actually feel.
If it doesn't look alive, it isn't done.
